ideas.pitch: An AI-powered workspace and room allocation management system designed for university campuses to streamline facility usage and event planning.
ideas.title: CampusFlow AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain familiar to university organisers in the room, mirroring the runner-up strategy of SpaceFlow at SmartHack'25.

ideas.pitch: An engineering team lifecycle intelligence platform that captures institutional knowledge before students graduate and helps incoming team members onboard.
ideas.title: DevArchive AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem judges and student project teams feel themselves, following the pattern of Northeastern's winning devflow project.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video and unstructured data intelligence platform that transforms messy campus lecture recordings and notes into searchable knowledge bases.
ideas.title: DocuSearch AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers immediate utility for educational institutions, utilizing multimodal processing similar to the Data & Design Hackathon winner LibrAI.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered smart garbage classification system combining computer vision with real-time feedback to automate campus waste segregation.
ideas.title: EcoSort Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates practical physical-world AI application with immediate real-world campus impact, echoing the TechnoMorph Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered RAG-based voice assistant designed to help university students instantly retrieve accurate administrative information.
ideas.title: CampusVoice RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high accuracy query retrieval and natural interaction, utilizing proven RAG patterns from the AIQoD Hackathon winner Voz-AI.
